order: Alternating baseline/current and current/baseline; a fresh process for each variant/workload/repetition.
scope: Real complete TGUIKit, native DrawingContext, FastBlur, CoreGraphics and the production CGImage extension. Opaque generated image fixtures, no camera capture, video decoding or Telegram account/UI.
memory: getrusage.ru_maxrss is the whole-process RSS high-water mark, including fixture creation and warmup; task_vm_info.phys_footprint is sampled after warmup and the measured loop. Native bitmap budget tests separately record DrawingContext.length.

provenance.test_instrumentation: TrackedBlur replaces only DrawingContext constructor calls with a recorder that returns a real TGUIKit.DrawingContext; NativeBlur and benchmarks use the unmodified production source.
